subject: Re: GreenGrid procurement lag — request for updated MAP and close guidance
messages:
From: Joel Marcus <joel.marcus@greengrid.com>
To: Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwood.ai>
Cc: Procurement <procurement@greengrid.com>
Date: Thu, 5 Mar 2026 16:12:00 -0700
Subject: Timeline risk — procurement delay at GreenGrid

Irene,

Quick heads-up from procurement: there is a mandatory vendor review that just moved to the week of Mar 22 (originally Mar 10). That puts our internal approval and SOW sign-off out by ~10–14 days if nothing else shifts.

We still want to close this quarter but procurement is asking for additional SOC2 evidence and a short internal security walkthrough (they want the SOC2_evidence.pdf we shared in the RFP). Can you share an updated mutual action plan (MAP) and a recommended revised close date? Also let me know whether a short trial credit or service-level concession is possible to keep momentum.

Attachments: procurement-checklist.pdf

Thanks,
Joel
Director, Strategic Partnerships
GreenGrid Health
joel.marcus@greengrid.com

From: Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwood.ai>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 5 Mar 2026 17:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Fwd: Timeline risk — procurement delay at GreenGrid (need MAP update + escalation)

Marissa / Ben — forwarding Joel's note. Procurement pushed the vendor review to the week of Mar 22, which will likely push close ~2 weeks. Joel asked for a revised MAP, SOC2 evidence handoff confirmation, and whether we can offer a short trial credit to preserve momentum.

Proposed immediate actions (please reply-all with decisions):
- Marissa: can you pickup MAP revision with week-by-week checkpoints and a compacted eval run (we can shorten the internal test window by swapping to targeted prompt sets)?
- Ben: confirm we can produce the SOC2 extract + attestations by Mon 3/8 and whether the security walkthrough (15–20m) can be scheduled the week of Mar 15. Also advise whether a 1-month trial credit (up to $5k) is approvable for AE-level signoff or needs leadership escalation.

I've sketched a fast MAP (attached) that re-anchors acceptance windows and includes a canary rollout plan. If we can get SOC2 pieces to them quickly and commit to the walkthrough, that should limit slip to two weeks rather than multiple sprints.

Attachment: GG-MAP-v3.xlsx

Thanks — Irene
Irene Choi | Enterprise AE, Redwood Inference
Phone: (415) 555-0142

From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
To: Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 6 Mar 2026 09:18:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Fwd: Timeline risk — procurement delay at GreenGrid (need MAP update + escalation)

Irene / Marissa — 3 quick things:
1) SOC2 extract: security can produce the requested artifact and a one-page attestation summary by Mon 2026-03-08 EOD. I confirmed with EngSec and they can join the walkthrough the week of Mar 15 for a 20-minute Q&A.
2) Walkthrough scheduling: suggest Tue 3/16 10:30am PT as a tentative slot (procurement usually keeps mornings).
3) Trial credit: I'm OK to approve a one-month trial credit up to $5k under the normal AE concession policy — no exec sign-off required. If we exceed $5k we'd need a leadership exception.

I'll loop Legal only if the customer asks for contract-level edits. From my POV the MAP revision + attestation + a scheduled walkthrough should be enough to keep the close to ~Mar 26.

Ben
Ben Carter | VP Sales Operations, Redwood Inference

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 6 Mar 2026 10:02:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Fwd: Timeline risk — procurement delay at GreenGrid (need MAP update + escalation)

Thanks Ben — that aligns with my suggestion. I've updated the MAP (v3) to compress the eval window and added two guardrails: a canary deployment after SOC2 attestation and a pre-acceptance performance gate based on a 3-prompt regression set.

Irene — please send the MAP and the attestation plan to Joel and procurement. Proposed revised close date: 2026-03-26 (tentative, pending walkthrough). Offer: one-month trial credit (up to $5k) with standard acceptance terms.

I'll also add an escalation step into the MAP that triggers if the walkthrough is delayed beyond Mar 18 — that step includes a short exec touch (15m) to re-align procurement and security.

Marissa
Marissa Cole | Sr. Director, Strategic Accounts, Redwood Inference

From: Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwood.ai>
To: Joel Marcus <joel.marcus@greengrid.com>, Procurement <procurement@greengrid.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 8 Mar 2026 08:41:00 -07:00
Subject: Updated MAP and attestation — proposed revised close 2026-03-26

Joel — thanks for the flag. Please find the updated MAP (attached) and a short plan for SOC2 evidence handoff + walkthrough. Summary below: 

Summary of changes
- Revised target close: 2026-03-26 (two-week slip)
- Compressed evaluation window to 5 business days with focused prompt sets (details in MAP v3)
- SOC2 attestation: Redwood will provide the requested extract and a one-page attestation by Mon 2026-03-08 (attached SOC2_evidence.pdf).
- Security walkthrough: proposed Tue 2026-03-16 10:30am PT (Ben's team to join).
- Commercial concession: 1-month trial credit up to $5,000 (AE level approval confirmed).
- Escalation trigger: if walkthrough not completed by 2026-03-18, schedule a 15-minute exec alignment call (Marissa will coordinate).

Attachments: GG-MAP-v3.xlsx, SOC2_evidence.pdf

Action items for GreenGrid
1) Confirm 3/16 10:30am PT or propose an alternate in that week.
2) Accept the compressed eval plan in the MAP so we can provision the canary rollout.
3) Confirm acceptance terms for the trial credit (one invoice credit applied after successful canary).

If you confirm, we'll lock dates and I will update the HubSpot deal to reflect the new close date and the concession.

Best,
Irene Choi
Enterprise AE, Redwood Inference

From: Joel Marcus <joel.marcus@greengrid.com>
To: Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwood.ai>
Cc: Procurement <procurement@greengrid.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 9 Mar 2026 11:04:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Updated MAP and attestation — proposed revised close 2026-03-26

Irene / team — thanks, this is helpful and appreciated. We can do Tue 3/16 10:30am PT for the walkthrough. Procurement will review the MAP and get back by EOD Tue 3/9 with any remaining checklist items.

We accept the proposed revised close of 2026-03-26 and the one-month trial credit (up to $5k). Please send the calendar invite and we will plan to proceed with the compressed eval.

Joel
Director, Strategic Partnerships
GreenGrid Health
